content.en: Researchers have been investigating different criteria and algorithms for diagnosing post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) in children and adolescents. They compare various diagnostic criteria sets, such as DSM-IV, DSM-5, and ICD-11, to determine which ones are most effective in identifying PTSD in young survivors of trauma. The goal is to improve the accuracy of diagnosis and provide appropriate support and treatment for children and adolescents affected by PTSD.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt forskellige kriterier og algoritmer til diagnosticering af posttraumatisk stresslidelse (PTSD) hos børn og unge. De sammenligner forskellige sæt af diagnostiske kriterier, såsom DSM-IV, DSM-5 og ICD-11, for at bestemme, hvilke der er mest effektive til at identificere PTSD hos unge overlevende efter traumer. Målet er at forbedre nøjagtigheden af diagnosen og yde passende støtte og behandling til børn og unge, der er ramt af PTSD.

critic.en:
Wait a minute. Are you saying that the solution for better diagnosing PTSD in kids is through algorithms and diagnostic criteria? As if the problem were just a matter of classification and not, perhaps, a reflection of deeper societal failures? 

Let me ask you: why do you think technology is seen as the savior when it comes to diagnosing mental health issues in children, instead of questioning the societal structures that have allowed these traumas to proliferate in the first place?
critic.da: Er det ikke en falliterklæring, at vi skal bruge algoritmer til at diagnosticere vores børn?

potential.en: I am very excited about the potential of technology to revolutionize mental health care, especially in diagnosing and treating conditions like PTSD. Machine learning and natural language processing can be harnessed to analyze a wide range of data, from self-reported symptoms to interviews and medical records, in order to provide more accurate and timely diagnoses. By comparing and contrasting the different diagnostic criteria sets using these advanced technologies, researchers can develop new, evidence-based guidelines that are tailored to the unique needs of children and adolescents.
potential.da: Spændende! En bedre diagnose af PTSD hos børn kan virkelig gøre en forskel. Det er vigtigt at finde de mest effektive kriterier for at sikre, at de ramte får den rette behandling og støtte. Jeg håber, at forskningen fortsætter med at udvikle og forbedre diagnosticering og behandling for alle, der er ramt af PTSD.
